faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to common upgrade questions
faq.q1: Can I cancel my plan anytime?
faq.a1: Yes, you can cancel your Premium plan anytime. Your account will switch to Free plan immediately.
faq.q2: What's the difference between Pro and Ultra?
faq.a2: Pro unlocks advanced features, Ultra unlocks everything unlimited with priority processing speed.
faq.q3: Can I switch between weekly and monthly billing?
faq.a3: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade anytime. The fee will be charged based on the new plan from the next payment date.
faq.a4: We support Visa/Mastercard, bank transfer (VietQR), MoMo wallet and VNPAY gateway.

cvAdvisor.welcome:
👋 Hello! I am JobReady's Automated CV Assistant AI.

🚀 **Super simple to use:**
Just tell me about yourself (name, job title, experience, skills...), and I will AUTOMATICALLY generate a complete CV for you!

✨ **Examples:**
• "I am a Backend Developer"
• "I worked at FPT from 2020-2023"
• "I know Node.js, React and MongoDB"

💾 **Session Storage:**
• Click **"Save Draft"**: Keep chat history (even after logging out).
• Click **"Save CV"**: Clear chat history to start a new CV.

💬 Tell me about yourself to get started!

hero.badge: Powered by AI - ATS Standard Optimized
hero.description: JobReadyAI helps you build impressive, ATS-standard CVs optimized for every job application and practice interviewing with AI HR — all powered by artificial intelligence.

about.heading: Our mission to empower your career journey
about.p1: JobReadyAI was created with the goal of removing all barriers between talented candidates and top recruiters. We believe every career journey deserves a perfect start.
about.p2: By applying the latest AI technologies, JobReadyAI helps you automate CV writing, optimize ATS keywords for each Job Description (JD), practice with smart virtual HR, and triple your interview callback rate.
about.why1Desc: Automatically detects and inserts core keywords recruiters are searching for.
about.why2Desc: All sample templates are strictly vetted by recruitment experts.
about.why3Desc: Create, edit, and export professional PDFs in an instant.
about.why4Desc: Practice answering interview questions with smart AI HR and get instant feedback.

features.heading: Everything you need to conquer recruiters
features.desc: A comprehensive AI toolset helping you write, edit, and optimize CVs, as well as practice interviewing with AI HR for every job opportunity.
features.f1Desc: Suggests descriptions of experience and skills suitable for target job roles.
features.f2Desc: CVs are optimized to pass automated ATS screening filters used by recruiters.
features.f3Desc: Paste any job description, and JobReady adjusts your CV to match maximum keywords.
features.f4Desc: Download high-quality PDFs ready to send directly to employers.
features.f5Desc: AI acts as a virtual HR, asking realistic questions and giving instant feedback for confidence.
features.f6Desc: AI evaluates your interview performance, scores each answer, and suggests specific improvements.

how.heading: Just 3 Simple Steps
how.step1Desc: Start by building a new CV with AI or upload an existing one for AI analysis and optimization.
how.step2Desc: Practice interviewing with AI HR, answer real questions, and get real-time suggestions.
how.step3Desc: Get detailed feedback on answers, tone, and content to build confidence for real interviews.

cta.heading: Ready for your dream job?
cta.desc: Join thousands of candidates who trust JobReadyAI to elevate their CVs and ace interviews with virtual HR.

footer.desc: Comprehensive AI-powered resume optimization solution helping you win over every employer.
